notes: Settings: Always on (start with Windows, stay awake), Claude Code, Security (rotate all keys), Publishing, Browser and computer.
The expanded model bar shows each model's level, sign-in state, health and address.
Who picks the model: Jev, Kev, Fastino GLiDE, GLiNER2.5-Decide and Not Diamond, and they learn from your changed picks and replies.
Share a message into another project's memory; publish pages; Chrome and computer use.
This update window: what's new, app updates, new models and Hermes releases.
Long chats shrink like Claude Code and Codex and stay alive.
No checks on read-only commands, so tools run faster.
Setup wizard: closing it ends it.
A lost reply is always recovered, and a closed Claude never holds its chat.
After a restart, waiting messages pause for one click.
Apps: a background watch suggests updates for each app.
The update watch follows your brief, reads videos by what is said, and shows its progress live.
The update watch's model picker sits beside frequency and Check now.
The update watch uses your connected models, Claude included.
Every model plans first and waits for GO before building.
Any file you drop gets into the chat.
A message sent while models load waits, then goes.
Faster tools: each window gets only the tools it shows, and lookups read only the rows they need.
Every model searches with rg.
A message stuck on Checking plugins ends after 60 s and names the step that stuck.
A new turn engine: Claude's own events decide when a chat is busy, so chats no longer stall.
Messages go to the model at once, and Stop stops only the running reply.
Every wait names its reason.
Themes: Black, High contrast and Warm paper join Dark and Light.
Appearance: Text size scales the whole app, and a Font menu lists the fonts Windows has, starting on Helvetica.
Messages typed while one is being prepared join it as one message.
A command waiting for Allow no longer holds up other chats.
While a message is routed, its label names who picks, then the model picked.
Trismegistus is now Ghidorah. Same chats, keys and settings; the III icon stays.
A message you add mid-reply shows where the model read it.
Models can rename apps and change their icons.
One GO covers every step of the job you approved.
Preview pages sit in the right place and open inside Ghidorah or in your browser.
Fork works again: background updates no longer leave rows that block it.
Only your words go into a running reply, so a question mid-job no longer ends the job.
Sends never wait for a summary, Hermes keeps its session, and plugins are checked only when they change.
Claude subscription models can write the routing summary.
The chat fills the window when the pane beside it is hidden.
In Bypass, a model starts Claude, Codex or Gemini without asking.
One look across the whole app: every screen uses the same colours, sizes and parts, in all five themes.
Title bar: Chat files, Export and Keyboard shortcuts sit in a menu after the chat title; the panels are one row of icons.
Under the message box: Attach, Voice, Dictate and Skills are icons; one line of controls with real switches and a context ring with its percent; the model pills sit on one line.
Sidebar: app tiles two to a row, one style for every heading, a dot on the right for unread chats.
Settings: search the sections; every setting is one row.
Export and Share no longer scroll sideways; Keyboard shortcuts and the window buttons follow light themes.
Sign in to Claude Code from Ghidorah: a button in Settings › Connections › Anthropic and on the Claude Code page.
When Claude Code is signed out, Ghidorah says so.
Ghidorah updates itself: it checks 4 s after it starts and every 3 hours, and downloads in the background.
A chip in the title bar shows the download, then restart to update. Click it, or just quit: the update installs then. Ghidorah never restarts by itself.
This window opens once after each update with what's new, and every version back to 0.1.0 in one scroll.
Your chats are copied before every install; the newest three copies stay beside your chats.
If a new version doesn't open, the one before comes back by itself, and this window says so.
Every version is on the public releases page, with a Download for Windows button. The installer asks where Ghidorah goes, and updates land there.
